title: Order Processing Service stuck in PROCESSING state
symptoms: Orders intermittently stuck in PROCESSING state
observations: Worker acknowledgement transactions failing to commit on retry
evidence: RabbitMQ unacknowledged message counter climbed to 8,200
Worker thread dump showed uncommitted DB transaction
verification: All orders transitioned to COMPLETED within 45s
root_cause: Worker acknowledgement transaction was not committed after a retry path in order message consumer.
resolution: Commit transaction before acknowledgement and restart affected order consumer workers.

timeline.event: Incident INC-HS-TEST-01 recorded for Order Processing Service
Incident resolved: Worker acknowledgement transaction was not committed after a retry path in order message consumer.
